_why: The repository's labels, as code. .github/workflows/labels.yml makes GitHub match this file whenever it changes, and test/labels.test.js checks that every label a tool or workflow relies on is here. Labels that exist on GitHub but not here are reported, never deleted: an issue may still carry one.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something does not work as it should

labels.name: regression
labels.description: Worked in an earlier release and stopped

labels.name: security
labels.description: A vulnerability or a hardening change

labels.name: needs-decision
labels.description: Waiting on the maintainer to decide

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Waiting on the reporter for details or the diagnostic archive

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: A new feature or an improvement

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: README, guides, the site or the documents in the repository

labels.name: question
labels.description: Asking rather than reporting

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Small, self-contained, a good place to start

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: The maintainer would welcome someone taking this

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: Already reported elsewhere

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: Not a problem with this project

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: Decided against, with the reason in the thread

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: A dependency update

labels.name: javascript

labels.name: github_actions
